obligations.description: - `FileManager.md` still cannot satisfy its own addendum requiring open-by-runtime-identity because its core open contract is path-only; `generated://` only covers preview restore, and `evidence_record` is still tier-keyed where attempt-native pivots are now required.
exact_items: - `FileManager.md` still cannot satisfy its own addendum requiring open-by-runtime-identity because its core open contract is path-only; `generated://` only covers preview restore, and `evidence_record` is still tier-keyed where attempt-native pivots are now required.
